info.title: Simple Tekla Extension Creator - scaffolds a Tekla Structures extension project.
info.description: Scaffolds new Tekla Structures extension starter projects (Console, WinForms, or WPF), optionally replacing the default beam-insertion example with Tekla Open API code extracted from an existing macro (.cs) file. Headless CLI tool.

options.name: --project
options.description: Name of the project to create.

options.name: --ui
options.description: Console, WinForms, or WPF. Default: Console.

options.name: --macro
options.description:
Path to a Tekla Open API macro (.cs) file whose 'Run' method body
(and any helper classes/methods) is copied into the generated project's
OpenApiCode.cs, replacing the default beam-insertion example.

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the generated project after creation.
